Book orders, downloads and billing review

Please check the book title, included titles, format and sample before ordering. PDF ebooks are delivered electronically after successful payment. Printed editions are currently out of stock.

Contact us if you received an incorrect or incomplete download, cannot access a purchased file, were charged twice, have an incorrect or unauthorised charge, or paid without receiving the product described. We will review your order, payment and delivery records and explain the resolution in writing.

Email care@pinnacleblooms.org with the subject Book order review, your order number, payment date and amount, the affected book and the resolution requested. You can also call 9100 181 181. Do not send passwords, OTPs, full card details or unnecessary information about a child.

Refund requests are assessed against the information and conditions disclosed before purchase and applicable law. Accepted refunds follow the authorised payment route. Bank processing times can vary.

Nothing in this policy removes applicable consumer rights or remedies. For escalation, reply with your earlier correspondence and request review by the responsible management team. Our Contact and Grievance Information explains the established contact route.

PDF delivery and printed editions

PDF ebooks are digital products. No printed copy or physical shipment is included.

After successful payment, download links are sent to the email address entered at checkout. Your purchase includes the book or books and digital format described on the product page. Page counts vary by edition; check the product page before ordering.

Check your order email and spam or junk folder if the download message is missing. For assistance, email care@pinnacleblooms.org with your order number and the email used at checkout, or call 9100 181 181. Contact us before purchasing the same item again.

Softcover and hardbound editions are currently out of stock. We are not accepting orders for these editions or promising a dispatch date.
